description: Resolve the cross-ligated ferredoxin tetrads and compare cluster counts across four activases
code:
import numpy as np, pandas as pd, json, re, itertools
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

seqs=json.load(open("activase_seqs.json"))
ACC={'YjjW_ECOLI':'P39409','BssD_THAAR':'O87941','PflA_ECOLI':'P0A9N4','NrdG_ECOLI':'P0A9N8'}
def sgs(acc):
    sg={}; pl={}
    for L in open(f"AF-{acc}.pdb"):
        if L.startswith("ATOM") and L[17:20].strip()=="CYS" and L[12:16].strip()=="SG":
            sg[int(L[22:26])]=np.array([float(L[30:38]),float(L[38:46]),float(L[46:54])])
            pl[int(L[22:26])]=float(L[60:66])
    return sg,pl

rows=[]
for n,acc in ACC.items():
    sg,pl=sgs(acc); s=seqs[n]
    rs=[m.start()+1 for m in re.finditer(r'(?=C...C..C)',s)]
    fer=[m.start()+1 for m in re.finditer(r'(?=C..C..C...C)',s)]
    def add(kind,cs):
        d=[np.linalg.norm(sg[a]-sg[b]) for i,a in enumerate(cs) for b in cs[i+1:]]
        rows.append(dict(protein=n,acc=acc,type=kind,site="+".join(f"C{c}" for c in cs),
                         n_Cys=len(cs),max_SG_SG=round(max(d),2),
                         mean_pLDDT=round(float(np.mean([pl[c] for c in cs])),1),verified=max(d)<=7.5))
    for i in rs: add('radical SAM',[i,i+4,i+7])
    if fer:
        # The two ferredoxin motifs cross-ligate: each [4Fe-4S] takes three Cys from one
        # motif and one from the other. Tetrads are therefore found geometrically, as
        # 4-cliques whose SG atoms are all within 7.5 A.
        pool=sorted(set(sum([[i,i+3,i+6,i+10] for i in fer],[])))
        tet=[list(c) for c in itertools.combinations(pool,4)
             if max(np.linalg.norm(sg[a]-sg[b]) for a,b in itertools.combinations(c,2))<=7.5]
        used=set(); 
        for t in sorted(tet,key=lambda t:max(np.linalg.norm(sg[a]-sg[b]) for a,b in itertools.combinations(t,2))):
            if used & set(t): continue
            used|=set(t); add('ferredoxin [4Fe-4S]',t)
S=pd.DataFrame(rows); S.to_csv("activase_FeS_sites.csv",index=False)
print("Iron-sulfur sites in the AlphaFold v6 models, verified by SG-SG geometry:\n")
print(S[['protein','type','site','n_Cys','max_SG_SG','mean_pLDDT','verified']].to_string(index=False))
cnt=S[S.verified].groupby('protein').size().reindex(list(ACC)).fillna(0).astype(int)
print("\nVerified cluster sites per activase:"); print(cnt.to_string())

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,4.6))
fer=[47,50,53,57,76,79,82,86]; sgW,_=sgs("P39409")
D=np.array([[np.linalg.norm(sgW[a]-sgW[b]) for b in fer] for a in fer])
order=[47,50,53,86,57,76,79,82]; oi=[fer.index(x) for x in order]
im=ax[0].imshow(D[np.ix_(oi,oi)],cmap='viridis_r',vmin=0,vmax=18)
ax[0].set_xticks(range(8),[f"C{x}" for x in order],rotation=45)
ax[0].set_yticks(range(8),[f"C{x}" for x in order])
for i in range(8):
    for j in range(8):
        ax[0].text(j,i,f"{D[oi[i],oi[j]]:.0f}",ha='center',va='center',fontsize=8,
                   color='white' if D[oi[i],oi[j]]>9 else 'black')
ax[0].add_patch(plt.Rectangle((-.5,-.5),4,4,fill=False,ec='#c53030',lw=2.5))
ax[0].add_patch(plt.Rectangle((3.5,3.5),4,4,fill=False,ec='#c53030',lw=2.5))
ax[0].set_title('YjjW ferredoxin cysteines, SG-SG distance (A)\ntwo cross-ligated tetrads, all contacts 5.5-6.5 A')
plt.colorbar(im,ax=ax[0],shrink=.8)

ax[1].bar([x.split('_')[0] for x in cnt.index],cnt.values,color=['#c53030','#2b6cb0','#718096','#718096'])
for i,v in enumerate(cnt.values): ax[1].text(i,v+.06,str(v),ha='center',fontsize=12)
ax[1].set_ylabel('verified [4Fe-4S] sites'); ax[1].set_ylim(0,3.6); ax[1].grid(alpha=.3,axis='y')
ax[1].set_title('YjjW has the three-cluster architecture of BssD\nPflA and NrdG have only the radical SAM cluster')
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
